formulas.name: fit
formulas.explanation: Centred cosine plus weighted distance in the 19-dim space; ML blended with alpha.

formulas.name: total_cost
formulas.explanation: Inflation-adjusted cost of the full course.

formulas.name: family_funds
formulas.explanation: Money the family can direct to education over the course.

formulas.name: loan_capacity
formulas.explanation: Present value of the maximum affordable EMI (annuity formula).

formulas.name: affordability
formulas.explanation: S = expected value of the best stack-compatible scholarship set.

formulas.name: roi
formulas.explanation: Earnings premium over a baseline path, discounted, per rupee spent.

formulas.name: conflict_index
formulas.explanation: Weighted parent-student gaps on 6 dimensions; bands aligned/mild/moderate/high.

formulas.name: final_score
formulas.expression: w_fit*fit + w_mkt*market + w_aff*afford + w_roi*roi + w_align*align - w_risk*disruption
formulas.explanation: Weights from the versioned scoring config; per-component contributions returned.

formulas.name: robustness
formulas.expression: mean Kendall tau(top-k base, top-k perturbed) over +/-20% weights
formulas.explanation: How stable the ranking is to reasonable changes in priorities.

fairness_safeguards: Gender, caste, religion and community are never used as scoring or model features.
Recommendations are explained per component so families can challenge any single factor.
Admin analytics are k-anonymised (groups smaller than k=5 are suppressed).
privacy_rules: Parents see financial/aspiration inputs and aggregate results, not the student's raw answers.
Students see their own traits and a gentle conflict summary, not raw family finances.
Raw answers or raw finances are shared only with explicit, revocable consent.
Minors need recorded parental consent before data processing.
limitations: Market, salary, cost and scholarship figures are illustrative estimates until verified.
Signals are periodic snapshots, not real-time feeds.
Psychometric items are original and not yet norm-referenced on a large Indian sample.
